verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU alijja n'ebire
Eyafiirira-abanyu;
Abatukuvu be bangi
Wamu naye bayimba,
Aleruuya!
Ajja wansi-okufuga.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Bonna baliraba Yesu
Ng'ali mu kitiibwa kye:
N'abo-abaamuyigganya
N'abo-abaamufumita
Balikaaba,
Yesu bw'alirabika.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Wansi ne waggulu wonna
N'ebirimu biriggwaawo-:
Abaamulyamu olukwe
Baliwulira Yesu
Bw'alisala,
Gubasinze,muveewo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Abeegendereza bonna
Abamulindirira
Balitwalibwa mu bbanga,
Balisangayo Yesu.
Eyeewayo,
Okuleeta-obulamu.

verse.name: v5
